pairs.target: miǎnde bāndòng shí xiàbā luàn xiǎng . "

pairs.english: “Lend me a hand,”

pairs.english: Pavo said.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shēnshǒu tuōzhù láng zuǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi reached out to support the wolf's jaw.

pairs.target: nà zhāngzuǐ bǐ kànshàngqù zhòng ,
pairs.english: That jaw was heavier than it looked.

pairs.target: tā tuō le yíhuìer ,
pairs.english: He held it for a while

pairs.target: cái xiǎngqǐ yīngdāng xiān wèn yào tuō duōjiǔ .
pairs.english: before remembering that he ought to ask how long he was to hold it.
pairs.hanzi: 才想起应当先问要托多久。

pairs.target: pà wò yǐjīng rào le liǎngquān ,
pairs.english: Pavo had already wound the rope around twice.

pairs.target: wényán biàn tíngxiàlái ,
pairs.english: On hearing that he stopped,

pairs.target: bǎ cǎoshéng wǎng zhuōshàng yì rēng . "
pairs.english: and tossed the rope onto the table.

pairs.target: nǐ fàngxià ba ,
pairs.english: “Go ahead and put it down.

pairs.target: wǒ běnlái xiǎng shìshì yígè rén néng bunéng bān . "
pairs.english: I'd meant to see whether I could carry it by myself.”
pairs.hanzi: 我本来想试试一个人能不能搬。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ lángtóu qīngqīng fàngzài ménkǎn nèicè .
pairs.english: Tavi gently set the wolf head down inside the threshold.

pairs.english: Pavo lifted one end of the wooden frame.

pairs.target: láng liǎn lìkè wǎng xià zāi ,

pairs.target: bízi chàdiǎn zhuàng shàng dì .
pairs.english: its nose almost striking the ground.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wǎngqián mài le bànbù ,
pairs.english: Tavi took half a step forward,

pairs.target: yòu tuìhuíqù .
pairs.english: then stepped back again.

pairs.english: Pavo changed to a different grip,

pairs.target: jiāng mùjià zhuǎnguò lái ,

pairs.english: so that the wolf faced him.

pairs.target: zhèhuí táiqǐ lái ,
pairs.english: This time he lifted it,

pairs.target: jiàn mén bèi yìzhī láng zhàn le ,

pairs.target: jiào tāmen tiāo gèbié de dìfāng liàn .
pairs.english: and told them to pick some other place to practice.
pairs.hanzi: 叫他们挑个别的地方练。

pairs.target: pà wò liánshēng dāying ,
pairs.english: Pavo agreed at once,

pairs.target: huítóu kàn tǎ wéi ,

pairs.english: There was no threshold in the courtyard,

pairs.english: but someone willing to come tomorrow evening and lift the other end.

pairs.english: Tavi asked what time.

pairs.english: and said when the lamps were lit.

pairs.target: ruò tǎ wéi méi lái ,
pairs.english: If Tavi didn't come,

pairs.english: he would ask someone else.

pairs.english: Tavi agreed.

pairs.target: bǎ bù tuán sāi huí láng zuǐ .
pairs.english: and pushed the wad of cloth back into the wolf's mouth.

pairs.english: This time the jaw still gave a rattle.
pairs.hanzi: 这回下巴还是响了一声，

pairs.target: shēnshǒu mōlemō mù láng de tóu ,

pairs.target: shuō tā yě dāying le .
